blender-any.clarifying_question: What specific thing do you want to animate? (e.g. a character walking, a product showcase, a logo reveal)

todo.objective: A single-user todo list app that lets someone create, check off, and manage tasks, assuming a standard mobile or web interface.

capabilities.reason: store tasks with properties like title, completion status, and timestamps
provide authenticated endpoints for creating, updating, and deleting todos
build the user interface where tasks are displayed and managed
ensure tasks persist across sessions and app restarts

knob.objective: Build a rotary knob that can be programmatically controlled to provide variable haptic resistance or detents and read its position.

capabilities.reason: design the knob housing and shaft to mount the encoder and motor
read the knob's rotary position accurately
drive the motor to create programmable torque resistance and detent feedback
coordinate encoder reading, motor control, and expose a programmable interface
supply adequate current for motor torque while powering logic

rc-truck.clarifying_question: What do you want to build with an RC truck — the truck itself, a modification, a controller, or something else?

screws.objective: A mechanical dispenser that releases screws one at a time, counts them as they're dispensed, and updates an online inventory database tracking parts in stock.

capabilities.reason: dispense one screw at a time from bulk storage
design the dispenser mechanism body and hopper
detect dispense events and trigger count updates
send count updates from the dispenser to the online database
design an inventory database schema for parts and counts
build an API to receive dispense events and update inventory

coaster.objective: A decorative PCB designed to function as a drink coaster, with copper artwork/traces forming the visual design.

capabilities.reason: draw a minimal schematic for the board (even if just decorative)
design the copper artwork and board outline as a PCB layout and send for fab
create visual artwork that works within PCB layer constraints (copper, silkscreen, soldermask)

birds.objective: Create an illustration of birds lined up on a beach, with correct perspective, composition, and natural bird poses.

capabilities.reason: compose the beach scene with correct perspective and arrange the birds in a readable line
draw each bird with convincing anatomy and natural standing poses
collect and study photo references of specific bird species and beach environments

apothecary.objective: Generate AI art of characters or scenes from The Apothecary Diaries in a consistent anime style.

capabilities.reason: drive the model to produce anime-style art matching the source material's aesthetic
keep Maomao, Jinshi and other characters recognizable across multiple generated images
evaluate composition and anatomy to select or refine outputs that actually work visually

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to 3D print?

fishtank.objective: Animate a short scene in Blender of a dish (likely a fish or lobster) looking out from inside a fishtank in a Chinese restaurant setting.

capabilities.reason: model the dish character, fishtank, and restaurant environment
rig the dish character with controls for animating eyes and body
animate the dish character's performance with believable timing and emotion
create materials for water, glass, restaurant lighting, and the character
frame and animate the camera to tell the story effectively

anime90s.objective: Render a 3D scene in Blender styled to look like 1990s anime, assuming cel-shaded characters with characteristic linework and color treatment.

capabilities.reason: need clean character or scene geometry to shade
achieve the cel-shaded, flat-color anime look with proper edge detection
build and light the scene so the NPR shading reads correctly
composite line passes, color grading, and period-appropriate grain or effects

gacha.objective: A mobile gacha game where players collect anime-style characters and engage in cooking-themed gameplay.

capabilities.reason: need a working scene flow between menus, gacha pulls, and cooking gameplay
core monetization mechanic requires drop rates, rarity tiers, and pity system
need touch UI for gacha interface, character collection, and cooking minigames
generate anime-style character art for the gacha roster
each character needs consistent appearance across card art, sprites, and cooking scenes
must save player collection, currency, and progression reliably

gridfinity.objective: A Gridfinity-compatible organizer bin with custom cutouts shaped to hold specific tools, so each tool has a fitted slot.

capabilities.reason: model the Gridfinity base grid and bin walls to spec
trace tool profiles and design cutouts that grip tools without being too tight
ensure the bin snaps into a Gridfinity baseplate correctly

pokemon-bin.objective: A 3D printed storage organizer for bulk Pokémon cards that groups them by color/type, with custom-fitted compartments.

capabilities.reason: model the box and divider compartments
size compartments to fit measured card dimensions with clearance
design stackable or modular connections between storage units
design and apply color/type labels for each compartment

golf-mount.objective: A 3D printed mount that attaches an iPhone securely to a golf bag and positions it to record the user's golf swing.

capabilities.reason: must measure iPhone dimensions and design a holder that grips it securely without a case slipping
must model the mount body and attachment mechanism in CAD
must design a clamp or strap interface that attaches firmly to the tubular frame or fabric of a golf bag without damaging it
must allow angle and orientation adjustment so the camera aims at the swing zone from a bag-mounted position
must survive outdoor UV, temperature swings, and vibration during transport on a golf cart

ledger.objective: A mobile app that tracks a user's stock portfolio holdings and performance over time.

capabilities.reason: build and deploy the mobile app interface
design a database schema for holdings, transactions, and historical performance
build a backend API with user authentication to store portfolio data
fetch and update current stock prices from a financial data API
allow users to view portfolio data offline and sync changes when online

dryer.objective: A wall-mounted device that blows warm air to dry the user's body after a shower, eliminating the need for towels.

capabilities.reason: design enclosure and mounting bracket for blower and heating element
ensure electrical components survive continuous bathroom humidity and water spray
size blower and heating element to deliver comfortable warm airflow across body surface area
safely wire heating element and blower to mains power in a wet bathroom environment
control heating element duty cycle and blower speed with safety shutoffs

verstappen.objective: Animate a Formula 1 race car (Max Verstappen's car) racing around a track.

capabilities.reason: model the F1 car and track environment
rig the car with working wheels that rotate and suspension that articulates
animate the car's motion with convincing speed and weight through turns
animate cameras that follow and showcase the racing action
create materials for the car livery, track surface, and environment
render and composite the final animation with motion blur

gundam.objective: Build a physical Gundam-style robot head that tracks and follows a person as they move around the room, with a transformation mechanism (e.g., faceplate or visor movement).

capabilities.reason: create the Gundam head geometry before fabrication or printing
model the mechanical parts, mounting plates, and motor brackets
design the transformation linkage (faceplate, visor, or antenna movement) that doesn't bind
detect person position in real time from a camera mounted on or near the head
convert noisy person detections into smooth pan/tilt servo targets
drive the pan/tilt servos and transformation mechanism servos in sequence
coordinate vision input, tracking logic, and servo outputs on the microcontroller
